name: Thirst Unending: a Blood Elf Venomancer's Arcane Torrent credits the Mana Wyrm objective (#4065)
contract: Report #4065: a level 2 Blood Elf Venomancer on Sunstrider Isle had no active racial and could not finish
'Thirst Unending' (8346), which asks for Arcane Torrent on a Mana Wyrm (15274). PR #5379 teaches Venomancers the
CoA mana variant 814287, and the Mana Wyrm's SmartAI casts Quest Credit 8346 (61314, kill credit for 15468) on
the invoker when hit by 814286-814292. 814287 silences enemies within 8 yd of the caster, so a Mana Wyrm beside
the Venomancer, spawned with its own neutral faction 7, must be hit and credit the quest.
